content: Windows fs.rename EPERM: on Windows, temp-file-then-rename pattern fails intermittently with EPERM when target held by transient lock (AV, search indexer, concurrent process) -- not atomic-safe like POSIX. Standard fix is retry with exponential backoff (100ms/200ms/400ms, ~3 attempts) on EPERM/EBUSY/EACCES; fallback to non-atomic writeFileSync in place if retries exhausted, to avoid losing writes entirely.
